transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, things at work have just been a little off lately. I'm a hairstylist, and I love my job, I really do. But... I don't know, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue or something. 

Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing color, which I've done a million times, it just... it takes me forever now. And I think people have started noticing that I’m just slower than I used to be. It's probably nothing major, just me being a little tired, right? I hope it's okay that I brought that up. Is that the kind of thing you need to know?
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um... well, I guess maybe a little bit? I mean, I don't want to sound ungrateful or anything, because I know I have a good life and a job I really care about. But... yeah, lately, most days I wake up and there's just this... this heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. 

It almost feels like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning, if that makes sense? But I try to push past it, I really do. I don't want to be a burden on anyone or bring the mood down at the salon. Is it normal to feel like that sometimes? I hope I'm not overreacting or anything.
Have you been having problems with your memory?

Um... I don't know if I'd call it a memory problem, exactly? I mean, I hope it's not. It's just... well, sometimes I'll be looking at the appointment screen, or I'll stare at my color formulas, and my brain just... blanks. 

It's honestly a little embarrassing. I end up second-guessing really simple things that I used to do automatically. I always double-check everything so I don't mess up a client's hair, I promise. I really try not to let it affect my work. It's probably just normal stress making me a little scatterbrained, right? Does that sound like the kind of thing you were asking about?
Have other people told you that you seem physically slowed down lately?

Um... well, actually, yeah, I kind of mentioned that earlier, right? About how things feel so slow at work? I hope it was okay that I brought it up then. 

But, um, yes... my manager did pull me aside the other day. She just said I seemed a little... sluggish, I guess? Like I was taking a lot longer with my clients. I told her I was just trying to be extra careful, which is true! I really don't want to do a bad job. But... yeah, my hands just feel so heavy, like I'm moving through glue. Even just mixing the bleach or sectioning, which I've done a million times. It's probably just me needing to catch up on sleep, though, right? I'm trying really hard to speed back up so I don't let anyone down at the salon.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like less than before?

Um... well, I guess... maybe a little? I mean, I still love doing hair, I promise I do. It's just... I don't know, lately I've been feeling a little different about things. 

I used to really love chatting with my clients, you know? And I'd always try to help the newer stylists if they needed a hand, or I'd go hiking with my friends on my days off. But recently... I don't know, I just kind of keep my head down at work. I mostly just try to avoid people, honestly. It's not that I don't like them! It's just... I feel like I don't have that spark in me right now, if that makes sense? Like the energy is just gone. 

I'm really trying to get back to being my normal, friendly self, though. I don't want anyone to think I'm being rude or ignoring them. Is it normal to lose your spark like that for a little while? I hope it's just a phase and I'm not making too big a deal out of it.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?

Um... oh. That's a... that's a heavy question. I mean, I would never actually do anything to hurt myself, I promise. I don't have a plan or anything like that. I know that would be terrible for my family and the salon. 

But... well, sometimes, when things get really overwhelming and I feel like I'm just messing everything up... I do get these thoughts. Just... like, maybe it would be easier if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up? That way nobody would have to worry about me or deal with me dragging them down anymore. 

It's a really awful thing to think, I know. I always try to push those thoughts away as soon as they pop up because I know I shouldn't think like that. I'm really sorry if that sounds bad. I'm just trying to be honest, like you want me to be. Is it... does that make me sound really crazy? I hope you're not disappointed in me for thinking that way sometimes.
Have you been feeling this depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Um... well... I guess so? I mean, I don't want to sound like I'm complaining all the time. I know I have a good job and a lot to be thankful for. But... yeah, for the last couple of weeks, maybe a bit longer... 

It's just... almost every morning, I wake up and there's this... this really heavy, flat kind of sadness right here in my chest. It just sits there. And it makes me feel like... like there's just no point in trying to build the life I've been planning, you know? With the salon and everything. 

I try to shake it off, I really do! I put on a smile for my clients because I know they don't want a sad hairdresser. But it's been there almost every day lately. Is it okay that I feel that way? I'm trying my best not to let it take over, I promise.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually energetic or high, unlike your normal self?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I have good days, of course! Days where I'm in a great mood and get a lot done at the salon, but... never anything where I felt, like, unusually high or out of control. 

I'm usually pretty steady when I'm not feeling down, I promise. I don't get all hyper or do anything reckless or weird. Is... is that okay? I hope it's a good thing that I don't get like that. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, and I definitely wouldn't want you to think I'm acting crazy or anything.
Before this recent period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?

Um... well, it hasn't really been just a recent thing. I mean, I don't want to make it sound worse than it is, because I really have been trying to manage it. But... this heavy feeling, this depression... it's actually been with me for a while. 

Like... maybe about a year and two months now? It's just kind of been this constant thing in the background. I really hope that doesn't make me sound like I'm not trying hard enough to get better. I've been doing my best to keep up with work and everything, I promise. Is it... is it bad that it's lasted that long? I just want to be totally honest with you so you can help me.
During this past year or so, was there ever a stretch of two months when you felt back to your usual self, without the depression?

Um... well... no, I don't think I ever had a full two months where it went away completely. I mean, I really wish I could say yes, because I want to be doing better, you know? 

But looking back at this whole... this whole time since it started... I've spent most of it just feeling really weighed down and depressed. There were definitely shorter stretches where the sadness wasn't quite as heavy, and I could push through it easier at the salon. I always try to make the most of those better days! But... no, it never really lifted for two whole months at a time. 

I hope it's okay that I haven't been able to shake it off for that long. I really am trying my best to stay positive when I can. Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm answering you right.
During this past year and two months, was there ever a period when your depression became much worse than usual?

Um... no, not really. I mean, it's just been kind of... steady, I guess? Like I said, I've been trying really hard to manage it, so I wouldn't say it ever got, like, completely unbearable or way worse than normal. 

I always try to push through and keep a smile on for my clients, so I don't let it get too out of hand. I mean, there are definitely harder days, but... no major crash or anything where it got significantly worse. I really hope that's what you were asking. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things have been. Is that... is that helpful?
